color.$description: Colour roles in the light theme. Each role says when to use it; the dark theme gives the same roles their dark values (color.dark.tokens.json).

surface.$description: A card, panel, dialog or field: anything that sits on the canvas.

surface-sunk.$description: An inset area inside a surface: code, a table header, a quiet button on hover.

border.$description: The line around a surface, field or table cell.

accent.$description: The one main action on a screen, links, the selected tab.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent background.

accent-subtle.$description: A quiet accent background: a selected row, an info notice.

accent-hover.$description: A solid accent control under the pointer.

success-subtle.$description: The background of a success notice or badge.

warning.$description: Needs attention but nothing failed: offline, expiring.

warning-subtle.$description: The background of a warning notice or badge.

pending.$description: Waiting on someone or something: an approval, a running job.

pending-subtle.$description: The background of a pending notice or badge.

danger.$description: Failed, refused, revoked, or an action that destroys something.

on-danger.$description: Text and icons on a danger background.

danger-subtle.$description: The background of an error notice or badge.

danger-hover.$description: A solid danger control under the pointer.

diff-added.$description: The background of a line a change adds (green).

diff-added-text.$description: The text of a line a change adds.

diff-removed.$description: The background of a line a change removes (red).

diff-removed-text.$description: The text of a line a change removes.
